capability: Solve one complex Maxwellian mode with a residual-checked bounded root graph.
operation: solve one seeded Maxwellian electrostatic mode
discovery.model: Same normalized Maxwellian electrostatic response as the companion operator
discovery.boundary: Only the branch reached from the supplied seed is claimed.

excluded: Source-project MATLAB behavior, graphics, global root scans and arbitrary analytic continuation.
preconditions: k is finite and strictly positive; outputs must remain representable in double precision.
supported: Finite positive real scalar k and finite normalized frequency, including representable complex upper/lower-plane values.

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic import solve_maxwellian_electrostatic_mode
r=solve_maxwellian_electrostatic_mode(0.4,1.45-0.1j)
assert r["normalized_residual"]+r["normalized_residual_error"]<=1e-9
assert r["normalized_residual_error"]<=2.5e-10
example.expected: The seeded solve returned omega=1.2850569696537468-0.066127958690749j after 15 evaluations; normalized_residual was 1.11e-15 and normalized_residual_error was 2.96e-13.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError for invalid, nonfinite, singular or incompatible inputs.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Raises RuntimeError when MINPACK fails, exceeds max_evaluations, or the normalized residual/error gate fails; no partial mode is returned.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No partial scientific result is returned after a failed call.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Unrepresentable evaluation raises ValueError; solver unrepresentable trial response raises RuntimeError. Unexpected SciPy execution errors propagate.

assumptions: MINPACK success is insufficient without the final residual check.
f0(v)=exp(-v²/2)/sqrt(2π), unit plasma frequency, thermal standard deviation one, perturbation convention exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Only the branch reached from the supplied seed is claimed.
identity.definition: Seeded solve of epsilon(omega,k)=0 using two real components, then a normalized residual and estimated-error gate independent of k² scaling.
identity.model: Same normalized Maxwellian electrostatic response as the companion operator
identity.relation: Seeded solve of epsilon(omega,k)=0 with error-aware normalized physical residual acceptance

inputs.constraints: Finite strictly positive real scalar; booleans, complex values and arrays rejected.
inputs.name: k

inputs.constraints: Finite strictly positive real scalar, booleans and arrays rejected.
inputs.name: xtol

inputs.constraints: Finite strictly positive real scalar, booleans and arrays rejected.
inputs.description: Acceptance threshold for normalized epsilon residual plus estimated error.
inputs.name: residual_tolerance

outputs.constraints: Finite and accepted only below residual_tolerance after estimated-error gate.
outputs.name: normalized_residual

outputs.constraints: Finite and accepted only below residual_tolerance/4.
outputs.description: Estimated epsilon error on the same normalization.
outputs.name: normalized_residual_error

title.zh: 种子 Maxwellian 静电模态

verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded to finite positive real k and representable complex frequency for the Maxwellian electrostatic mode. Evidence: `test_generalized_dispersion_d2.py` contains 4 test functions, 1 of which references `solve_maxwellian_electrostatic_mode`, and is shared by 3 assets; `test_generalized_dispersion_d2_successor.py` contains 7 test functions, 1 of which references `solve_maxwellian_electrostatic_mode`, and is shared by 3 assets; `test_generalized_dispersion_numerical_repair.py` contains 11 test functions, none of which references `solve_maxwellian_electrostatic_mode`, and is shared by 3 assets; only shared-file coverage is bound, so a pass is file-level rather than asset-isolated; the bounded example was executed by this audit. Oracle: self-consistency/regression only. It does not establish global root scans or arbitrary analytic continuation.
known_limitations: The estimated error is not a rigorous enclosure.
No uniqueness, least-damped branch or global root selection claim; supplied seeds select branches.

Only two direct functions exist across the three shared generalized-dispersion files (`test_maxwellian_root_checks_residual` and `test_small_k_maxwellian_limit_is_three_quarters_and_false_seed_rejected`); the eleven-test repair file contains no direct call.
scope: Current SciRel implementation and the repository tests listed in this contract cover the declared public ports and numerical relation.
The example exercises one bounded representative case; it does not extend applicability beyond the declared preconditions.

references: Hua-Sheng Xie, Generalized plasma dispersion function, Physics of Plasmas 20 (2013), 092125.
